metadata.purpose: Allow overlap to the concurrency limit; buffer excess source objects in arrival order.

conditions: T* is each inner source; the outer delivers inner-source identities, not plain values.
An accepted inner contributes zero or more values; ignored, replaced or queued inners have policy-specific lifetimes.
This Cω-inspired shape excludes completion, error and cancellation, which are specified by guarded rules.

scope.callbacks: No user callback. A deterministic identity microstep maps an admitted outer source token to itself without time advancement or throwing.
scope.time: No clock or scheduler is created. Outer and inner sources supply time; same-time delivery order is explicit in the input sequence.
scope.reentrancy: Non-reentrant reactions with synchronous projection outcomes. Exact teardown traces assume source initialization has returned before terminal events.
exclusions: The identity microstep is a modeling refinement of the implementation, not an actual callback or a scheduling boundary.
Arbitrary ObservableInput conversion, reentrant source/observer/finalizer behavior and synchronous nested teardown equivalence are outside the exact-trace profile.
Invalid concurrency, throwing observers, and producer-abort guarantees are out of scope.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Acquire one outer subscription; no projection or inner subscription before an accepted outer value.

ownership.sharing: No sharing or replay introduced. Each result subscription owns its counter, active-inner bindings and queue; an inner producer may itself be shared.
ownership.reset: Fresh bookkeeping per result subscription. Closed has no admissible events. Payloads and source tokens are retained by reference.

resources.owner: this result subscription; generation is its admission index
external projection binding; generation correlates the invocation

dispatch.actionSemantics: Commit next state, then interpret the ordered actions. A return is resolved before the next external input. Never replace RxJS delivery with an implicit event FIFO.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between fully resolved reactions; release the outer if still open and all active inners; discard queued values without completing.
Outer completion is not cancellation of admitted or queued inner work.

rules.nextState: outer open with index zero and no active inners or queued values
rules.explanation: Subscription connects to the outer source. Pipeline construction alone starts no identity conversion or inner execution.

rules.guard: a concurrency slot is available and the index can advance
actions: request one projection with the input and admission index
rules.nextState: one pending projection; index advanced once
rules.explanation: An accepted outer value invokes the identity conversion once with that value and the next zero-based admission index. The returned inner source is subscribed only after identity conversion succeeds.

rules.nextState: append the raw outer value to the FIFO queue without changing the projection index
rules.explanation: When all slots are occupied, retain the outer value in arrival order. Do not project it yet. A later inner completion admits the oldest queued value.

rules.guard: matching invocation with resume=Active; result is identical to pending inner source
actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: A successful identity conversion starts its inner subscription. The outer input itself is not forwarded; values come from the admitted inner.

rules.guard: matching invocation with resume=Draining; result is identical to pending inner source
actions: subscribe the returned source under the pending invocation generation
rules.nextState: new inner admitted; no outer value emitted directly
rules.explanation: Queued outer values still get received after outer completion. Their inner subscriptions must also finish before the result can complete.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: Values from admitted active inners are forwarded unchanged in actual delivery order.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: An active inner error ends the whole result, including the outer subscription and other active inners.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: Downstream cancellation unsubscribes from the outer and every active inner. It neither completes the result nor projects queued values.

rules.guard: matching inner; queue nonempty; projection index can advance
actions: dequeue the oldest value and request its projection
rules.nextState: one slot reserved for the dequeued input; other inners remain active
rules.explanation: When an inner completes, release it and admit the oldest queued value into the free slot. Its identity conversion runs now, not when it originally arrived.

rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: An inner completing does not complete the result while the outer is still open. Wait for more outer values or other active inners.

rules.guard: the notification belongs to an active inner generation
rules.nextState: retain the same active set and queue
rules.explanation: After the outer completes, values from remaining inners continue to flow until those inners finish.

rules.guard: the error belongs to an active inner generation
actions: release all owned subscriptions and discard queued values
rules.explanation: An inner error while draining still ends the result immediately; other inner work and any queued values are discarded.

actions: release the open outer and active inners; discard the queue without notifying downstream
rules.explanation: Cancellation while draining releases the remaining inners and discards queued work without completion.

rules.guard: matching inner; queue nonempty; projection index can advance
actions: dequeue the oldest value and request its projection
rules.nextState: one slot reserved for the dequeued input; other inners remain active
rules.explanation: Outer completion does not discard the queue. Continue admitting queued values as inner subscriptions finish.

rules.guard: matching inner, empty queue, and another inner remains
rules.nextState: remove that inner and keep waiting
rules.explanation: When one of several remaining inners completes, keep waiting for the others.

rules.guard: matching final inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: The result completes only when the outer has completed and all admitted inner work, including any queue, is finished. The final cleanup order follows this operator family under the post-setup profile.

rules.nextState: outer done; preserve active inners and queued values
rules.explanation: Outer completion stops new arrivals but does not cancel the current inner work. Keep forwarding inner values and, where applicable, draining the queue.

rules.guard: no active inner and empty queue
rules.explanation: If the outer completes with no inner work left, complete immediately and release the outer subscription.

actions: release the outer and active inners; discard the queue
rules.explanation: An outer error is forwarded immediately. Unlike completion, it cancels active inners and discards queued values.
